title: Carpio’s camp: Inquirer address given in good faith in Lustre's warrant
summary: MANILA, Philippines – Atty. Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, provided the Philippine Daily Inquirer’s office address as Philip Lustre’s last known address in “good faith,”…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Atty. Manases Carpio, husband of Vice President Sara Duterte, provided the Philippine Daily Inquirer’s office address as Philip Lustre’s last known address in “good faith,” Carpio’s spokesperson, Atty. Neil Abayon, said on Thursday. Lustre, a veteran journalist, was arrested last Saturday on a cyberlibel charge without having received a complaint beforehand because the subpoenas had been sent to the wrong address. “The Inquirer’s business address was furnished in good faith as the respondent’s last known ascertainable professional address. The subsequent claim that the address is not his residence does not, by itself, invalidate the complainant’s reasonable reliance on […]...
